title: Verdict
description: What one flow did when it was exercised in a real browser. Small enough for a coding agent to reason over; complete enough to fix the bug without re-running.

flow.description: Flow id from flows.yaml, e.g. login

status.description: blocked means the flow could not even start, e.g. server down or login prerequisite failed

action.description: What the agent actually did, e.g. click button 'Sign in'

url.description: Page URL after the failing action

console.description: Console errors and warnings during the flow, newest last, trimmed

network.description: Requests that returned 4xx/5xx or did not complete

screenshot.description: Path to the screenshot at the failing step, relative to the project

suspects.description: Repo paths, optionally with :line, most likely to own the bug. Filled by the triage step, empty when unknown

note.description: One or two sentences a human would want to read. Nothing else goes here
